alpacawork setup

row.data: Keep    Data              {{subject}} (your tasks and history; delete it by hand when you no longer need it)
row.holdsData: Keep    Holds the data    {{subject}} (not removed: it is the data folder or contains it)
row.notOurs: Keep    Releases folder   {{subject}} (not removed: it holds entries alpacawork did not put there)
row.record: Keep    Record            {{subject}} (not removed: it names the data folder, so a later run protects it the same way)
row.releases: Remove  Releases          {{subject}} (what alpacawork put there; the folder itself only when nothing else is in it)
row.skillsUnknown: Keep    Skills            {{subject}} (not removed: the skill record is unreadable, so alpacawork cannot tell which skills are its own)

service.blocked:
{{why}} Nothing was changed.
To remove the registration by hand, run these ({{alreadyGone}}):
{{commands}}
Then run alpacawork uninstall again.
service.conflict: The auto-start registration {{name}} differs from what alpacawork registered, so uninstall will not touch it.
service.left:
The auto-start registration {{name}} was not fully removed{{fault}}. The server may be stopped now, but it is still registered to start at login.
Nothing else was removed. To get a working alpacawork back, run alpacawork setup. To finish removing it, run alpacawork uninstall again.
If uninstall stops here again, remove the registration by hand with these ({{alreadyGone}}):
{{commands}}
service.unavailable:
The user service manager cannot be reached, so uninstall cannot tell whether the auto-start registration {{name}} is still there, or remove it. Nothing was changed.
Run alpacawork uninstall from a normal login session (on WSL2, with systemd enabled).
service.uninspectable: The auto-start registration {{name}} cannot be inspected: {{failure}}.
service.unrecorded: An auto-start registration named {{name}} exists, but no installation record describes it.

uninstall.stoppedAt:
Uninstall stopped at {{subject}}: {{failure}}
What was already removed stays removed. Fix the cause, then run alpacawork uninstall again; it removes what is left.
uninstall.title: Remove alpacawork from this PC
uninstall.unreadableRecord:
The installation record {{path}} exists, but this version of alpacawork cannot read it: it was written by another version, is damaged, or is another user's. Only this record names the data folder, the releases folder and the auto-start registration, so uninstall will not guess at them. Nothing was changed.
Run alpacawork uninstall with the alpacawork version that wrote it (npm install -g alpacawork@<that version>), as the user it belongs to.
To remove alpacawork by hand instead, first remove the auto-start registration (the record names it; for the default name these are the commands, and {{alreadyGone}}):
{{commands}}
Then, after checking in the record that your data folder is not inside any of them, delete: the releases folder {{releases}} (or the one the record names), {{state}}, the skills listed in {{receipt}}, and last {{config}}.
